acceptance: Red test first: a 3-rune prompt that appears on the input line is not reported pending.
100% statement coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Add a floor of 8 runes to the text that pendingAtInputLine compares; below the floor the check returns not-pending and logs the reason.
source: operator decision 2026-11-03, docs/plans/architecture-decisions-2026-11.md AD2-0/AD3-4; survivor of bridge-prompt-hardening
summary: pendingAtInputLine in go/internal/bridge/driver_tmux_submitverify.go matches the prompt text at the input line. A very short match can be a coincidence on the pane, so the check can call a prompt pending when it was submitted, or the reverse.
title: The tmux submit check needs at least eight runes of the prompt at the input line before it calls a prompt pending
